source: Placeholder prices (day-web-offers, 2026-11-20). They will be replaced from the research team's RESEARCH.md. Starter matches the Agency CRM's Starter ($499 + $49).

packages.name: Starter site
packages.pitch: A fast, clean site that gets the phone ringing: built from the demo they already saw.
includes: Up to 3 pages: home, services, contact
Tap-to-call and a contact form that emails them
Their logo, photos and words
Works great on phones; loads in about a second
Their own domain set up (domain cost included the first year)
Google Business Profile linked
Care plan: hosting, security updates, small edits every month

packages.name: 3D Showcase
packages.pitch: The site people remember: their product, space or work in 3D you can spin with a finger, still fast on a phone.
includes: Everything in Starter, up to 6 pages
One interactive 3D scene: product, room, vehicle or menu item (from photos or a model)
A still-image fallback for old phones and reduced motion
Scroll story on the home page (what they do, in 3 steps)
Quote or booking request form
Speed checked on a real phone before launch
Care plan: hosting, updates, one small 3D change a quarter

packages.name: Growth retainer
packages.pitch: A site that keeps bringing customers: a new page or offer every month, local search, reviews and a monthly report in plain words.
includes: A Starter-size site to begin (or a takeover of their current one)
Every month: one new service page or seasonal offer
Google Business Profile posts and review replies (drafted, they approve)
Local search basics: page titles, map listing, citations
One-page report each month: calls, form leads, where they came from
Minimum 3 months, then month to month

terms.title: 50 % deposit to start
terms.text: Work starts when the deposit is paid. The other half is due the day the site goes live, before it is switched on.

terms.title: What is included is written down
terms.text: The proposal lists the pages and features. Anything new (an extra page, a shop, a new 3D model) is quoted first, in writing, before any work.

terms.title: Two rounds of changes
terms.text: Two rounds of changes are included before launch. More rounds are billed by the hour at your rate, agreed first.

terms.title: Client sends photos, logo and words
terms.text: The clock starts when the client sends their photos, logo and words (or buys the writing / photo extras). Late content moves the date, not the price.

terms.title: Hosting and the domain
terms.text: The domain is registered in the client's name. Hosting is part of the monthly plan; if they stop paying, the site is handed over or switched off after 30 days notice.

terms.title: Who owns what
terms.text: Once paid in full, the client owns their words, photos, logo and domain. You keep the right to reuse your own code and templates and to show the site in your portfolio.

terms.title: Monthly plan: cancel with 30 days notice
terms.text: The care plan or retainer is billed on the same day each month. Either side can stop it with 30 days notice; the Growth retainer has a 3-month minimum.

terms.title: Late payment
terms.text: An invoice is due in 14 days. After 30 days late, edits pause until it is paid.

terms.title: Logins stay with the client
terms.text: The client keeps the passwords for their domain and Google account; you get your own login, never theirs.
